title: EndpointAuth
description:
How an endpoint authenticates inbound public requests (§3, M2).

Internally tagged so the two shapes are structurally distinct: `bearer` cannot exist without a `vault_ref`, and `none` cannot carry one.

oneOf.description: Public. Anyone who can reach the ingress URL can call it.
Requires a bearer token matching the secret at `vault_ref`. Needs an `endpoint → vault (read)` wire; a mismatch is a 401 with no body.
